paragraphs: Rav Shmuel son of R' Avahu. He said, “My father was among Rafram's resh kallei”: Ellu Terefot, 49a. A karkuz goat was in the exilarch's household, and so forth. Rav Ahai prohibited it; R' Shmuel bar Avahu ate it, applying to himself, “From the fruit of a man's mouth his belly shall be satisfied.” They sent from there: “The halakhah follows Shmuel bar Avahu, but take care concerning our master Ahai, for he enlightens the eyes of the Diaspora”—show him honor, discuss the halakhah before him until he retracts, and do not permit in his presence what he prohibited. Ellu Terefot, 59b.
